listing.name: Dance Dance Revolution 1st Mix — ddr-1st-recomp (bmbelo87)
listing.summary: The project reports startup, animation, synchronized music and arrows, and fixes for specific freezes. Complete tracks and a full playthrough are unconfirmed; Portcove has not confirmed gameplay. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Japan SLPM-86222 40-track disc. The documented data file is 14935200 bytes with MD5 57d6ae6568a77409abfc94ba1d695b62. Your originals remain yours; Portcove has not downloaded or run the game files or player for this guide.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract the boot executable from your own disc, follow PSXRecomp generation and rebuild instructions, then build/run.sh. Portcove has not exercised the separate setup-host release route or confirmed the resulting player.
